about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Filipino Tapsilog Beef and Garlic Rice
recipes.summary: Thin soy and calamansi-style marinated beef with garlic fried rice and a fried egg, the classic silog plate.
steps: Mix the beef with the soy sauce, lemon juice, sugar, pepper and half the garlic, then leave to marinate for 30 minutes.
Fry the remaining garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 1 minute until golden, add the rice and toss for 4 minutes until hot and lightly toasted.
Fry the beef in a hot pan in two batches for 3 minutes each, until browned and cooked through at 71°C.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Serve the rice with the beef, an egg and sliced tomato on each plate.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef slices right through and the egg whites until fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable. Cool leftover rice within an hour and refrigerate it, eating it within a day.

recipes.title: Filipino Longsilog Sausage and Egg Breakfast
recipes.summary: Sweet garlicky pork sausages with garlic rice, a fried egg and a quick vinegar dip.
steps: Cook the sausages in a pan with a splash of water over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through at 75°C.
Fry the garlic in half the oil for 1 minute until golden, add the rice and stir-fry for 4 minutes until hot.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Mix the vinegar, onion and pepper for the dipping sauce.
Plate the rice with the sausages and eggs and serve with the dip.
notes: Food safety: cook the sausages until 75°C in the centre and the egg whites fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable. Cool leftover rice and refrigerate it within an hour.

recipes.title: Filipino Ginataang Kalabasa Pumpkin in Coconut Milk
recipes.summary: Pumpkin and green beans simmered in coconut milk with garlic and ginger, creamy and lightly savoury.
steps: Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the pumpkin and coconut milk and simmer for 12 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Add the beans and fish sauce and cook for 4 minutes until the beans are bright and just tender.
Season with the pepper and serve with rice.
notes: Swap the fish sauce for soy sauce to keep it plant-based.

recipes.title: South African Bobotie Breakfast Muffins
recipes.summary: Curried beef mince baked in muffin tins under a savoury egg custard, a handheld take on bobotie.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 6-hole muffin tin.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the mince, curry powder and turmeric and cook for 8 minutes until browned.
Stir in the jam, lemon juice, sultanas and soaked bread, then press the mix into the muffin holes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and pour over each muffin, then top with a bay leaf.
Bake for 20 minutes until the custard is set and golden, with the mince at 75°C.
notes: Food safety: cook the mince until 75°C all the way through and the egg custard until fully set. Chill leftovers within 2 hours and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: South African Potjie Style Butternut Soup
recipes.summary: Butternut, carrot and apricot simmered in one pot with mild curry spice and blended smooth.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry powder for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin, carrot, apricots and stock and simmer for 22 minutes until all the vegetables are very soft.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the coconut milk and lemon juice.
Reheat gently for 2 minutes and serve hot.
notes: Freezes well for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: South African Boerewors Breakfast Roll
recipes.summary: Coiled spiced beef and pork sausage in a soft roll with fried onion and tomato relish.
steps: Cook the sausage in a pan over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through at 75°C.
Fry the onion in the oil in a second pan for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Split the rolls and spread with chutney.
Fill with the sausage cut in pieces, the onion, tomato and rocket.
notes: Food safety: cook the sausage until 75°C in the centre with no pink inside.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Firfir Spiced Torn Flatbread
recipes.summary: Torn flatbread soaked in a warm berbere-spiced tomato sauce, a classic Ethiopian morning dish.

items: 4 flatbreads (or large wraps), torn into pieces

steps: Cook the onion in a dry pan for 4 minutes, add the oil, garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the chilli powder and paprika and tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and glossy.
Add the water and salt and simmer for 3 minutes, until the sauce is loose and glossy.
Fold in the torn bread and toss for 2 minutes until it has soaked up the sauce.
notes: Serve with a fried egg on top if you like.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Azifa Green Lentil Salad
recipes.summary: Cold lentils dressed with mustard, lemon and chilli, a zesty fasting-day salad.
steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until tender but holding their shape, then drain and cool.
Whisk the lemon juice, mustard, oil, ginger and salt.
Toss the lentils with the onion, chilli, parsley and dressing.
Chill for 15 minutes before serving.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

recipes.title: Peruvian Huancaina Sauce for Potatoes
recipes.summary: Creamy yellow chilli and cheese sauce that is spooned over boiled potatoes and egg.
steps: Soak the bread in the milk for 5 minutes.
Blend the feta, bread and milk, chillies, garlic, oil and lime juice until smooth and creamy.
Arrange the potato slices on a platter and pour the sauce over.
Top with the halved eggs and olives.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs for at least 10 minutes until fully set. Keep the sauce in the fridge and use within 2 days.

recipes.title: Peruvian Quinoa and Avocado Salad
recipes.summary: Fluffy quinoa with avocado, corn, tomato and lime, a fresh Lima-style lunch salad.
steps: Simmer the quinoa in 400ml water for 14 minutes until the water is absorbed, then cool.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin and salt.
Toss the quinoa with the avocado, corn, tomato, onion and coriander.
Pour over the dressing and fold gently.
notes: Add a handful of toasted pepitas for crunch.

recipes.title: Peruvian Tacu Tacu Rice and Bean Cakes
recipes.summary: Day-old rice and canned beans fried together into crisp golden cakes with garlic and chilli.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and chilli in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Roughly mash the beans, then mix with the rice, cumin, salt and the onion mix.
Shape into 4 thick patties.
Fry in the remaining oil for 4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Scatter with parsley and serve hot.
notes: Top with a fried egg or avocado.

recipes.title: Peruvian Crema de Zapallo Pumpkin Soup
recipes.summary: Smooth pumpkin soup with garlic and a touch of cumin, finished with a swirl of cream.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the cumin, pumpkin and stock and simmer for 18 minutes until very soft.
Blend until completely smooth.
Stir in the cream, reheat gently for 2 minutes and scatter with coriander.
notes: Use coconut milk in place of cream for a dairy-free soup.

recipes.title: Argentinian Salsa Golf Seafood Sauce
recipes.summary: Sweet pink mayonnaise and ketchup sauce served with prawns, ham and palm hearts on every Buenos Aires menu.
steps: Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice and paprika until smooth and pale pink.
Taste and add the pinch of salt as needed.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with cooked prawns, boiled egg or crisp chips.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

recipes.title: Argentinian Ensalada Rusa Potato Salad
recipes.summary: Diced potato, carrot and peas bound with mayonnaise and egg, a staple of Argentinian tables.
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrots in salted water for 12 minutes until just tender, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until firm, then peel and chop.
Drain the vegetables well and cool completely.
Fold in the mayonnaise, lemon juice, eggs and parsley.
Chill for 15 minutes before serving so the flavours settle.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until fully set and keep the salad cold, eating within 2 days.

recipes.title: Argentinian Tortilla de Papas Potato Omelette
recipes.summary: A thick golden omelette of sliced potato and onion, flipped and served warm or cold.
steps: Cook the potato and onion in the oil over low heat for 15 minutes, turning, until very soft but not browned.
Beat the eggs with the salt, then fold in the warm potato mix.
Pour back into the pan and cook for 6 minutes over low heat until the base is set.
Flip using a plate and cook for 3 minutes more until the egg is fully set.
Rest for 5 minutes and slice.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelette until the egg is fully set in the centre.

recipes.title: Indian Aloo Tikki Chaat
recipes.summary: Crisp spiced potato patties topped with yoghurt, tamarind and mint chutneys.
steps: Mix the potato, cornflour, cumin, garam masala, chilli and half the coriander and season, then shape into 8 patties.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until crisp and golden.
Whisk the yoghurt until smooth.
Plate the patties and top with yoghurt, tamarind sauce, mint chutney, onion and the remaining coriander.
notes: Serve straight away so the patties stay crisp.

recipes.title: Italian Insalata di Riso Summer Rice Salad
recipes.summary: Chilled rice with tuna, olives, tomatoes and capers, a picnic favourite across Italy.

items: 2 cans tuna in oil (185g each), drained

steps: Cook the rice in boiling salted water for 12 minutes until tender, then drain, rinse and cool.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until firm, cool, peel and quarter.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and salt.
Toss the rice with the tuna, tomatoes, olives, capers, parsley and dressing, then top with the eggs.
notes: Food safety: keep the salad chilled and eat within 2 days. Boil the eggs until fully set.

recipes.title: Italian Fagioli all Uccelletto Tuscan Tomato Beans
recipes.summary: Cannellini beans simmered with sage, garlic and tomato, an easy Tuscan side or light meal.
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic and sage for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, chilli, salt and pepper and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the beans and simmer for 12 minutes until the sauce clings and thickens.
Serve the beans spooned over the toasted bread.
notes: Finish with a little extra virgin olive oil.

recipes.title: Italian Salsa Verde Piemontese Parsley Sauce
recipes.summary: Punchy parsley, caper and anchovy sauce served with boiled meats and eggs.
steps: Soak the bread crumbs in the vinegar for 5 minutes.
Finely chop the parsley, capers, anchovies and garlic together.
Mix in the bread, egg yolk and oil until it forms a loose, rich sauce.
Rest for 10 minutes so the flavours meld.
notes: Food safety: boil the egg for at least 10 minutes until fully set. Keep chilled and use within 3 days.

recipes.title: Italian Bagna Cauda Warm Anchovy and Garlic Dip
recipes.summary: Warm olive oil and butter dip with garlic and anchovy, served with raw and roasted vegetables.
steps: Cook the garlic gently in the oil and butter for 8 minutes without browning.
Add the anchovies and stir for 4 minutes until they melt into the oil.
Pour into a small pot over a candle or low heat to keep warm.
Serve with the vegetables and bread for dipping.
notes: Keep the heat low so the garlic stays sweet and does not turn bitter.

recipes.title: Italian Pesto alla Trapanese Almond and Tomato Pesto
recipes.summary: Sicilian pesto of raw tomato, almonds, garlic and basil tossed through pasta.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente.
Blend the tomatoes, almonds, garlic, basil, oil, cheese and salt into a rough sauce.
Drain the pasta, keeping 60ml of the water.
Toss with the sauce, loosening with the water until glossy.
notes: Use vegetarian hard cheese to keep this vegetarian.

recipes.title: Egyptian Ful Medames Breakfast Beans
recipes.summary: Mashed warm broad-style beans with garlic, cumin and lemon, a daily Cairo breakfast.
steps: Warm the beans in a pot with 100ml water for 8 minutes, until hot.
Mash roughly with the garlic, cumin and salt.
Stir in the lemon juice and half the oil.
Spoon into bowls and top with tomato, parsley and the remaining oil, then serve with warm pita.
notes: Add a boiled egg on top for extra protein.

recipes.title: Moroccan Msemen Layered Pan-fried Pancakes
recipes.summary: Folded square pancakes of semolina dough, crisp outside and soft within, eaten with honey.
steps: Knead the flour, semolina, salt, sugar and water for 8 minutes until smooth, then rest for 15 minutes.
Divide into 6 balls and brush with oil.
Stretch each ball thin on an oiled bench, fold into a square and press flat.
Cook in a hot pan for 3 minutes each side until golden and flaky.
Serve with melted butter and honey.
notes: Brush each pancake with butter while hot for extra flakiness.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Dukkah Egyptian Spice and Nut Blend
recipes.summary: A dry crumbly mix of toasted hazelnuts, sesame, coriander and cumin for dipping bread in olive oil.
steps: Toast the hazelnuts in a dry pan for 5 minutes, then rub off the skins.
Toast the sesame, coriander and cumin seeds in the pan for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Crush everything together coarsely with the pepper and salt.
Dip bread in olive oil, then into the dukkah.
notes: Store in a jar for up to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: English Bubble and Squeak Fried Leftover Veg Cakes
recipes.summary: Mashed potato and cabbage fried until crisp, topped with a poached egg and bacon.
steps: Mix the potato, cabbage, onion and pepper and shape into 4 patties.
Fry the patties in the oil for 5 minutes each side until deeply golden and crisp.
Grill or fry the bacon for 5 minutes until crisp.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Top each cake with bacon and an egg.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and the egg whites fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Portuguese Molho de Piri Piri Chilli and Lemon Sauce
recipes.summary: A bright, hot sauce of chilli, garlic, lemon and olive oil for brushing over grilled food.
steps: Warm the oil with the chillies and garlic over low heat for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Cool slightly, then blend with the lemon juice, vinegar, paprika, salt and oregano.
Pour into a clean jar and seal while still slightly warm.
Rest for an hour before using.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Scottish Cranachan Oat Porridge with Apple and Honey
recipes.summary: Creamy oats finished with cream, honey and raspberries in the style of the Scottish dessert.
steps: Simmer the oats with the milk and salt for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Spoon the porridge into two warm bowls.
Top with the apple, honey and a swirl of cream.
Scatter over the toasted oats.
notes: Stir through a spoon of yoghurt for extra tang.
